summary.text: Alexis Hansen is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 32 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Alexis Hansen assumed office representing Nevada State Assembly District 32 on November 7, 2018.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Education, Judiciary and Natural Resources committees.
